new.text:
Weekly sync 2026-10-13
# Weekly sync 2026-10-13

Attendees: Maya Okafor, Tom Lindqvist, Priya Raman, Daniel Reyes, Sofia Marchetti, Kenji Watanabe

## Decisions and updates
- Public launch happened on 2026-10-06 as planned; early clinic feedback is good.
- SMS reminders will move from Vonage to Sinch on 2026-11-01; Vonage is out.
- Priya will redesign the SMS reminder templates for Sinch by 2026-10-30.
- The possible move from Plain to Zendesk was not decided; review Plain's new pricing and revisit in December.
- Product analytics will move from self-hosted PostHog to PostHog Cloud in the EU region.
- Releases will ship twice weekly, on Tuesdays and Thursdays, still behind feature flags.
- Concierge onboarding is live for all pilot clinics and the help centre is updated; the onboarding rollout task is done.
- Dark mode for the day view is now in beta.
- Investor updates return to monthly; keep the metrics dashboard link.
- The design system will change from the Tailwind UI kit to shadcn/ui.
- Several receptionists again requested per-practitioner calendar colours; no decision or action was recorded.

## Sources
- Tom Lindqvist, 2026-10-14: PostHog Cloud decision.
- Daniel Reyes, 2026-10-15: Tuesday/Thursday release decision.
- Kenji Watanabe, 2026-10-15: onboarding completion and day-view dark mode beta.
- Maya Okafor, 2026-10-16: investor cadence and design system decisions.

# Decision - SMS reminder provider is Sinch

Decided on 2026-10-13 by the weekly sync attendees.

## Decision
Move SMS reminders to Sinch from 2026-11-01. Vonage is no longer the provider.

## Rationale
Vonage continues to fail on Portuguese numbers.

## Replaces
The earlier decision to use Vonage.

# Decision - Product analytics vendor is PostHog Cloud (EU region)

Agreed on 2026-10-14 by Maya Okafor and Tom Lindqvist.

## Decision
Switch product analytics from self-hosted PostHog to PostHog Cloud in the EU region.

## Rationale
Self-hosting PostHog is consuming too much operations time while keeping clinic data in the EU remains required.

## Replaces
The earlier decision to use self-hosted PostHog.

Decision - SMS reminder provider is Vona.name: Decision - SMS reminder provider is Vonage
Decision - SMS reminder provider is Vona.text:
Decision - SMS reminder provider is Vonage

# SMS reminder provider: Vonage

Decided on 2026-10-02 by [[Tom Lindqvist]].

## Decision
SMS reminder provider is **Vonage**.

## Why
Messagebird delivery failures in portugal.

This replaces [[Decision - SMS reminder provider is MessageBird]], which is no longer current.

## Context
Accessibility review flagged low contrast on the cancelled-appointment chips. Support volume is highest on Monday mornings before 10am. Reception teams keep asking for fewer clicks when moving appointments.

Decision - Product analytics vendor is P.name: Decision - Product analytics vendor is PostHog self-hosted
Decision - Product analytics vendor is P.text:
Decision - Product analytics vendor is PostHog self-hosted

# Product analytics vendor: PostHog self-hosted

Decided on 2026-09-25 by [[Maya Okafor]].

## Decision
Product analytics vendor is **PostHog self-hosted**.

## Why
Clinic data must stay in the eu.

This replaces [[Decision - Product analytics vendor is Mixpanel]], which is no longer current.

## Context
Clinic owners care about no-show rates more than any other metric. Accessibility review flagged low contrast on the cancelled-appointment chips. A few clinics want per-practitioner colours on the calendar.

Decision - Release cadence is continuous.name: Decision - Release cadence is continuous deploys behind feature flags
Decision - Release cadence is continuous.text:
Decision - Release cadence is continuous deploys behind feature flags

# Release cadence: continuous deploys behind feature flags

Decided on 2026-10-04 by [[Tom Lindqvist]].

## Decision
Release cadence is **continuous deploys behind feature flags**.

## Why
Weekly batches hid regressions.

This replaces [[Decision - Release cadence is weekly releases every Thursday]], which is no longer current.

## Context
Exports to CSV are used weekly by clinic managers for payroll. Support volume is highest on Monday mornings before 10am. Load testing showed the booking endpoint is fine up to 300 requests per second.

Decision - Investor update cadence is fortnightly update with a metrics dashboard link

# Investor update cadence: fortnightly update with a metrics dashboard link

Decided on 2026-08-16 by [[Priya Raman]].

## Decision
Investor update cadence is **fortnightly update with a metrics dashboard link**.

## Why
Brightpath wanted more frequent numbers.

This replaces [[Decision - Investor update cadence is monthly email update on the first Monday]], which is no longer current.

## Context
Reception teams keep asking for fewer clicks when moving appointments. Calendar sync with Google and Outlook still drops edits made within the same minute. Clinic owners care about no-show rates more than any other metric.

# Public launch date: 6 October 2026

Decided on 2026-08-11 by [[Tom Lindqvist]].

## Decision
Public launch date is **6 October 2026**.

## Why
Calendar sync bugs pushed the date.

This replaces [[Decision - Public launch date is 15 September 2026]], which is no longer current.

## Context
We discussed whether SMS reminders should be sent 24 or 48 hours ahead. Load testing showed the booking endpoint is fine up to 300 requests per second. A few clinics want per-practitioner colours on the calendar.
